caption_argument_segments: If I had to start my LinkedIn again, this would be my exact plan:

→ 0 to 500: Prove you exist ↳ Pick one outcome (growth, clients, authority) ↳ Choose 2-4 content pillars & stick to them ↳ Comment on 10 posts every day ↳ Post 3 x per week minimum ↳ Write as you talk
☑️ Your only goal here is not quitting.

→ 500 to 2K: Get specific. ↳ Name your audience (title, industry, problems) ↳ Study top performing posts & do more of that ↳ Reply to every comment for 60 mins after posting ↳ Share what's working and what failed
